note: The Chat wrangler configs declare no [triggers]/crons, so the deployed Cloudflare cron expression is dashboard-owned and cannot be read from the repository. CRON_SCHEDULE must be entered at install time from that dashboard value. This manifest keeps the source-declared lane, the Worker dispatch and the timer units 1:1; .github/tests/test_com2_cron_parity_261031.py fails when they drift.
